title: Senior December Exam Exemption Incentive
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
SENIOR 

INCENTIVE  SENIOR INCENTIVE

Attention Seniors and Senior FamiliesIn an effort to incentivize what employers, admission representatives, and our community members alike say are some of the most important aspects of being successful: Showing up every day, arriving on time, and performing the assigned work well...THS students may be exempt from certain exams in December if they meet all 4 of the following thresholds during Quarter 2:(1) B or better in the course.(2) No more than 3 total unexcused tardies/early releases.(sum of tardies/early releases to/from school and all classes)(3) 0 unexcused absences - meaning all absences must be accompanied by a parent/guardian or doctor's note. Only 10 parent/guardian notes are available for use per school year.(4) No discipline referrals!

summary:
**Seniors can be exempt from certain December exams** if they meet all four criteria during Quarter 2:
- **B or better** in the course
- **No more than 3 total unexcused tardies/early releases** (to/from school and all classes combined)
- **0 unexcused absences** (all absences must have parent/guardian or doctor's note; only 10 parent notes available per school year)
- **No discipline referrals**

title: Winter EOC Testing Schedule and Information
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
WINTER 

EOC 

TESTING WINTER EOC TESTING

Individual Testing: 12/2-12/8 Individual testing is for students who still need to meet graduation requirements and first time testers who are not taking that class at THS. Emails will be sent to student & primary parent/guardian emails before Thanksgiving Break stating which tests need taken and testing date/time/location. Make up testing: please contact Mrs. HessClass Testing: 12/15-12/18Class testing will ONLY be done for students who are currently taking an Algebra C or Government class and will be taken during exam week. Emails will be sent to student & primary parent/guardian emails after Thanksgiving Break stating which tests need taken and testing date/time/location. Make up testing: 1/6-1/7Results will be available in ProgressBook in late February. To access results of all EOC tests: log in to ProgressBook, click on the Assessment Scores tab then End of Course Assessments. ELA and Algebra 1 scores 684 and higher are considered passing. Geometry, Biology, American History, and Government scores 700 and higher are considered passing. School counselors will update graduation plans with these scores. Please reach out to your school counselor with any questions regarding what your results mean for you.

summary: **Winter End of Course (EOC) testing** will occur in two phases: **Individual testing December 2-8** for students needing to meet graduation requirements and first-time testers not currently in the class, and **class testing December 15-18** during exam week for students currently taking Algebra or Government. Emails will be sent to students and parents with specific testing details before (individual) and after (class) Thanksgiving Break. **Make-up testing** is available December 2-8 (contact Mrs. Hess) and January 6-7. Results will be available in ProgressBook in late February—passing scores are 684+ for ELA and Algebra 1, and 700+ for Geometry, Biology, American History, and Government.

title: Sophomore BRAVE Day Anti-Bullying Event
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
Brave 

Day Brave Day

Sophomores BRAVE Day at Talawanda High School is our annual family building and diversity event for our Sophomore class. The focus of the day is on making students realize that they are not alone at Talawanda, and they have many other peers and adults that care about and support them. Our students are a large part of our community, and by sharing stories, participating in activities, and most importantly - listening - they realize the important role they play with their classmates. Since 2009, BRAVE Day has been an influential part of our Anti-bullying, personal empowerment program at THS and our students come out of this experience better people for it.The event will take place…FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 13THThe effort that our students put into the day is an amazing thing to witness. Not only do students participate, they also encourage each other throughout the day on a level that is not normally seen in a typical High School. As a School District we appreciate their willingness to let go of their normal day and try to become a better person. Talawanda is thankful for them, and realizes that we have some of the most caring students around.If you feel your student would not benefit from the day, or would be negatively affected by the activities provided, they are not required to attend. We will not force students to participate, but rather want to provide the opportunity for them to improve as Talawanda students during BRAVE Day. They should stay in class during the event if they do not want to attend.

summary: **BRAVE Day** is Talawanda High School's annual family building and diversity event for sophomores, focused on anti-bullying and personal empowerment. The event takes place **Friday, November 13th** and helps students realize they are not alone by sharing stories, participating in activities, and listening to peers. Students are encouraged but not required to attend—those who choose not to participate should stay in their regular classes.

Additional information about the One Plan can be found on the Ohio Department of Education and Workforce, linked here.If you have feedback to share or would like to be part of the parent/community advisory group for our One Plan, please contact Ms. Stephanie Aerni, Director of Teaching & Learning (AerniS@talawanda.org). There will also be a feedback session on 11/19/26 ahead of the School Board Meeting at the THS Performing Art Center.

summary: Families are invited to review the **TSD One Plan** on the district website—Talawanda is in year one of the current plan. Additional information is available on the [Ohio Department of Education and Workforce website](https://education.ohio.gov). To provide feedback or join the parent/community advisory group, contact **Ms. Stephanie Aerni** at AerniS@talawanda.org. A **feedback session** will be held on **11/19/26** before the School Board Meeting at the **THS Performing Art Center**.
